title: Which My Hero Academia character are you? Free MHA quiz — cv.cm
description: Free My Hero Academia quiz: answer 12 questions to find out if you're Deku, Bakugo, Todoroki, Uraraka, Iida, Tsuyu, Kirishima or All Might. Unofficial MHA fan quiz, no sign-up.
h1: Which My Hero Academia character are you?
lede: Determined like Deku, explosive like Bakugo or cool and quiet like Todoroki? Answer 12 questions about training, friends and pressure to find your My Hero Academia match.
about: Kohei Horikoshi's My Hero Academia, a manga from 2014 to 2024 with a hit anime, is set in a world where most people have a superpower called a Quirk and the best of them train to become professional heroes. Its students and teachers are as memorable as their powers: Izuku "Deku" Midoriya, the hero fan who never gives up; Katsuki Bakugo, who wants to be number one; calm, reserved Shoto Todoroki; warm, upbeat Ochaco Uraraka; rule-loving class rep Tenya Iida; frank, steady Tsuyu Asui; loyal, big-hearted Eijiro Kirishima; and All Might, the smiling Symbol of Peace. This quiz matches you with one of these eight.

Your result names your character and shows your scores for all eight. The questions are about personality, not story events, so there are no spoilers. This is an unofficial fan quiz written for cv.cm. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Kohei Horikoshi, Shueisha or studio Bones; the names belong to their owners.

deku.name: Deku (Izuku Midoriya)
deku.body: You're kind, hardworking and endlessly determined. You study everything, you notice details others miss and you'll throw yourself into helping someone even when you're scared. People underestimate you, until they see how far you'll go for others. Just look after yourself too.

bakugo.name: Katsuki Bakugo
bakugo.body: You're fiercely competitive, confident and full of fire. You set the highest bar for yourself, you hate losing and you work harder than anyone to stay on top. Behind the noise you care a lot. Let people see that more often, and it'll be easier to build a team around you.

todoroki.name: Shoto Todoroki
todoroki.body: You're calm, reserved and very capable. You keep your feelings close and don't need the spotlight, but your quiet strength and honesty win people over. Opening up a little more will bring you the friendships you deserve.

uraraka.name: Ochaco Uraraka
uraraka.body: You're warm, upbeat and down to earth. You lift people up, you work hard for the people you love and you keep going with a smile. Just remember your own worries matter too, and it's fine to share them.

iida.name: Tenya Iida
iida.body: You're responsible, organized and principled. You take your duties seriously, you keep everyone on schedule and you always try to do the right thing. Loosen the rules now and then; your friends love you for more than your timetable.

tsuyu.name: Tsuyu Asui
tsuyu.body: You're honest, calm and dependable. You say what's on your mind, kindly but plainly, and you keep a cool head when others panic. People trust your judgment because you never pretend.

kirishima.name: Eijiro Kirishima
kirishima.body: You're loyal, brave and big-hearted. You stand by your friends, you never back down from what's right and your enthusiasm is infectious. You may doubt yourself sometimes, but everyone around you knows they can count on you.

allmight.name: All Might
allmight.body: You're a natural inspiration: positive, generous and the one people feel safe around. You show up with a smile, you lift others and you care about being someone they can believe in. Remember even a symbol needs rest and people to lean on.
